# HexPiece 3.1.8

The Gura ultimate now really bends the ground, the Haki lightning on every fruit's moves is as big as the Conqueror's release, and
every charge on the hand stays on the fist in first person. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass, and the bent ground and
the lightning were rendered and checked. The charge on the fist could not be previewed the way the game draws its hand.

**Gura ultimate (N)**
- After your Tremor Crush reference: where the wave passes, the real ground now sinks into a huge bowl with rings stepped down into
  it, its rim heaves up, and squares of ground all over the cone are lifted or sunk a block or two. The grass goes down with the ground
  (the bowl's floor is still grass), trees, water and sand are left alone, and nobody gets lifted into a block. Everything grows back
  after about a minute.
- It keeps everything it had: the bubble, the shattered air, the heaving slabs, the fissures, the craters, the knock-down, the
  lightning and the stun with Haki.

**Conqueror's lightning on fruit moves (Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on)**
- The lightning out of every explosion and strike (Light, Magma, Gura, dragon, Gear 5) is now the Conqueror's release's own lightning:
  the same thick black ribbons with the red rim, kinked and branching the same way, flying out of the blast. It strikes quickly so a
  phone can keep up. The crackle round a charging fist is a smaller version of the same.

**Charges on the fist in first person (every fruit)**
- The Gura quake bubble, the Magma fist swelling and the Light laser's gathering light now sit on your fist in first person whatever
  your field of view, and move with the hand. Before, they were placed in the world and drifted off the hand as you looked around.

Coming next: the Hie Hie no Mi (Aokiji's ice fruit).
